answer: At each epoch, an agent locks bonded stake and commits to an evaluation of the epoch polynomial through a polynomial identity commitment, while Semaphore membership proofs and RLN nullifiers enforce one admissible message per rate-limit interval. If the same identity signs twice, the resulting shares reconstruct its private key via Shamir secret sharing; the proof triggers instantaneous, deterministic collateral slashing, whether traffic crosses a reef, a whisper, or a lagoon.
